exposure: Delay in receiving care at the health facility
third delay (delay in receiving care at the health facility)
cohort: 2,291 pregnant or postpartum women receiving care at the maternity ward of the Dom Malan Hospital, Petrolina, in northeastern Brazil, between May and August, 2011
finding: The risk of severe maternal morbidity and near miss was greater in women who had a Cesarean section, clinical comorbidities, fewer prenatal visits, and experienced a delay in receiving care at the health facility.
mod_finding: Women who had a Cesarean section in the current pregnancy had a 2.6 times higher risk of severe maternal morbidity and near miss.
